title: Felix and the Confession
author: Edmund Nystrom
blurb: Bram Iversen, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
